description: Implement Web Crypto AES-256-GCM encryption and decryption helpers, including 12-byte random nonce generation.
Implement SHA-256 hashing helpers and timing-safe equality utilities for secure comparisons.
Create D1 Database schema migrations for auth tokens, api keys, model registry, cost ledger, and rollups.
Implement repository layer for Auth Tokens, ensuring tokens are encrypted before storage.
Implement repository layer for API Keys. Ensure no plaintext keys are stored; use AES-256-GCM.
Implement repository layer for Cost Ledger and Rollups, handling int64 microdollars for financials.
Implement repository layer for the Model Registry.
